PluginManifest.Name: Kurisu.VoiceOverTools
PluginManifest.Title: Dialogue System Voice Over Helper
PluginManifest.Description: Voice-over asset helpers for dialogue projects. Rename VO files to a consistent {hexId}_{culture} scheme, clean up orphaned audio assets not referenced by any DialogueFragment, and strip non-primary translations + voice-over references in one pass. All commands include a dry-run preview.
PluginManifest.Tags: Voice-Over, Dialogue, Asset Management, Rename, Localization
PluginManifest.ReleaseNotes: V1.0.0- Initial release version V1.0.1- Purge Voice Over and Translations Feature V1.0.2- Added "Clean Up Orphaned Voice-Overs" command with dry-run / delete-Articy / delete-Articy+disk options. Added dry-run preview window to Rename commands with per-entry status (already correct / will rename / display-only / target exists / source missing) and click-to-navigate. New Articy-style dark theme for all plugin windows. Bug fixes: RemoveVoiceOvers now resumes localization state handling on exception; silent-placeholder WAV is cleaned from disk after removal; removed dead helpers and unused imports. V1.0.3- Plugin renamed from Kurisu.VoiceOverNamingScheme to Kurisu.VoiceOverTools (manifest Name, C# namespace, assembly, filenames). NOTE: this is a breaking rename — Articy treats it as a new plugin; uninstall the old one via Package Manager before installing 1.0.3. No behavioral changes. V1.0.4- Added "Audit Voice-Overs" command (Global): scans every DialogueFragment and flags VO references that are missing for a language, corrupted (broken proxy / file missing on disk / 0-byte file), or overlapping (the same audio asset is shared by multiple distinct fragments). Read-only diagnostic with per-category filter toggles and click-to-navigate (Show Fragment / Show VO Asset). V1.0.5- Audit Voice-Overs filtering: hard-filter excludes fragments with no Speaker assigned (narration / stage directions don't get false-positive "Missing VO" entries). New per-character dropdown filter combines with the category toggles. Each row's header now includes the speaker name for at-a-glance scanning. V1.0.6- Audit row redesign for transparency. Each entry now shows the navigator path of the fragment, the actual dialogue line in the audited language, and the issue detail in a structured 4-line layout with proper visual hierarchy (category icon + label, speaker, id+lang, path, quoted line, detail). Full ComboBox / ComboBoxItem template overrides so the character-filter dropdown is properly themed (was unreadable in dark mode previously). V1.0.7- Audit property + empty-line filtering. Each row now shows which text property the issue is for (.Text, .PreviewText, etc.) as a small monospaced badge in the header. New per-property toggle row dynamically built from the property names found in the audit (hidden when only one property type is present). New "Include empty lines" checkbox — hides rows whose dialogue text is blank by default (fragments not yet written), opt-in to include them. V1.0.8- Audit by-path filter + UX polish. New "Path:" dropdown listing all path prefixes found in the audit (top-level folders, sub-folders, deeper) — picking a prefix narrows results to fragments under that branch. Works at any depth. All filters (categories / property / character / path / include-empty) consolidated into the summary panel for a cleaner hierarchy. Custom-templated CheckBox so the empty-lines toggle blends with the dark theme (was previously default-WPF-styled and out of place). Third grid row simplified to nav-buttons-only. V1.0.9- Audit UX iteration. Empty-lines toggle promoted from a separate checkbox to a 4th category-style pill (off by default) so all primary filters share the same visual language. Character + Path filters moved back to the toolbar row alongside the Show buttons. Path picker rebuilt as a hierarchical ContextMenu — top-level folders cascade rightward into subfolders to any depth, with a "(this folder)" entry under each parent so you can filter at any intermediate level. Themed MenuItem / Separator / ContextMenu so the dropdown matches the dark palette. V1.0.10- Audit dropdown stripe fix. ContextMenu is a logical-tree island in WPF — implicit MenuItem styles defined at the Window level were not propagating into it, so menu items rendered with the default Aero template (white-on-light icon column gutter on the left). Fixed by merging the theme dictionaries into the ContextMenu's own Resources and assigning the themed style explicitly to every MenuItem and Separator built in code. V1.0.11- Stripe fix v2 + Kurisu submenu. v1.0.10 didn't fully eliminate the white stripe in the path picker. v1.0.11 extracts the ControlTemplates as keyed resources and assigns them DIRECTLY on the ContextMenu and every MenuItem in code (Style propagation through Popup boundaries is unreliable in WPF). Also overrides Aero's role-keyed SubmenuItem/SubmenuHeader templates so the default never gets a chance to apply. V1.0.12- Kurisu submenu (correct separator). Articy uses BACKSLASH not slash as the submenu separator in CaptionLid (per https://www.articy.com/adxdevkit/html/writing_a_plugin.htm). v1.0.11 used 'Kurisu/' which Articy rendered as a literal flat command name. Switched to 'Kurisu\\' so all five commands now actually group under a Kurisu submenu in the ribbon and right-click menu. V1.0.16- Multi-bound warning in the rename planner. New 6th category-style toggle "Multi-bound" (visible by default) — counts and optionally hides plan entries whose VO asset is bound to >1 distinct DialogueFragment project-wide (not limited to the rename scope, since the underlying file is shared across all bound fragments). Multi-bound rows render with a tinted background regardless of toggle state. Pre-execute confirmation dialog: when the actionable plan (Will rename + Display only) contains any multi-bound entries, a warning dialog explains the failure mode (each bound fragment overwrites the asset's filename + display + ExternalId, so only the last-processed fragment ends up with correct metadata) and offers Cancel / Proceed. No change to rename behavior — this is informative + a confirmation gate, not a code-path branch. V1.0.15- Fix: rename pass's "Rename Complete" report flashed open then immediately closed, leaving Articy in a stuck-modal state where the main UI was unresponsive as if a dialog were still open. Root cause: Session.ChangeAsset internally pops its own ProgressDialogWrapper for each reimported asset; Session.WaitForAssetProcessing waits for assets to be clean but not for the progress dialogs' close events to drain off the UI dispatcher. When the report opened against that pending state, MessageBoxEx.GetTargetWindow returned the dying progress dialog as the owner, and the report closed with it. Fix: drain the dispatcher to ApplicationIdle priority inside ShowReport before showing, so progress-dialog cleanup completes and Keyboard.FocusedElement settles on the main Articy window first. Drain is shared so the cleanup-orphaned report path also gets the protection. V1.0.14- Filter MarkupText alongside BBCodeText in the new tools' text-property iteration. Both are calculated CustomProperty views over the same underlying .Text (BBCodeText = BBCode rendering, MarkupText = XAML rich-text rendering used by the in-app rich-text editor) — they're not independent text fields. Including MarkupText produced phantom duplicate-translation groups that mirrored the .Text groups exactly. Now matched against Articy's own internal exclusion pattern for these two property names. V1.0.13- Two new tools. "Find Duplicate Translations" scans every DialogueFragment's localized text properties and groups together fragments whose non-reference-language text is byte-identical — useful for spotting copy-pasted translations that should have differed. Picker for reference language (defaults to project primary), comparison toggles (case-insensitive, collapse whitespace, include groups where every member shares the same reference text), and view filters (offending language, character, navigator path). Per-row Clear / Clear from others; footer Clear-all-filtered with per-language confirmation breakdown. "Find Multi-bound Voice-Overs" inverts the audit's Overlapping view into a per-asset listing — one entry per audio asset bound to more than one DialogueFragment, with a sub-row for each binding. Group header has Play (system audio decoder), Show VO Asset, and asset metadata; sub-rows have Clear / Clear from others. Optional toggle to also flag intra-fragment overlaps. Clears use the API-supported null assignment for VoiceOverReferences (verified against the live LocalizationHelper.SetAudioSample chain).
